verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own stack tooling acts on many items in one action. `cafe stack submit` pushes each commit as its own branch and opens one pull request per commit, and Land merges the whole stack bottom-up. GitHub import also brings over repositories with all their issues, pull requests and reviews at once. Beyond these stack and import flows, there is no general bulk-edit capability; CLI flags like `--json` and `--yes` are only scripting building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: general bulk actions on arbitrary sets of issues or PRs (e.g. bulk label, close or assign), bulk endpoints in the API or MCP server, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: `cafe stack submit` pushes each commit after the base as its own branch and opens or reuses one pull request per commit.
